quote: [DR3] presses that the only named Davidic man is Joseph; neither chain forces the other.
why: The judge text counts no verse on a cited-in line as an unanswered witness: the Genesis 46:26 and Hebrews 7:10 citations are offered as the defender's answers, and the challenger's pressing is only paraphrased, so K-G4's conditions for counting a witness are never invoked.
